guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul / SG (Gurewitz), Gibson Les Paul (Hetson)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Gurewitz and Hetson are known punk guitarists generally playing Gibson solid-bodies, no single iconic model.
guitar.notes: Kept essentially as-is, slight wording cleanup.

tone.target: bright punk crunch with tight downstroke bite
tone.profile: bright punk crunch with tight downstroke bite
tone.summary: A punchy, aggressive rhythm tone built around a UK 45/UK 50 style amp simulation, paired with a bright cab and minimal effects to maintain raw energy.
corrections: use dry crunch, not high gain
keep it more raw than polished
